requiredFindings.title: The overlay leaves the accepted M3 planning record unresolved and calls r10 a draft
requiredFindings.problem: IMPLEMENTATION.md says the current M3 r10 record is explicitly a draft, uses r10 only for navigation, and requires the exact accepted plan revision to be resolved before this amendment is published. PLAN-AMENDMENT-r2.md does not name that revision. The Codex review of those r10 bytes is ACCEPT with no required findings. r10 remains a planning record and is not contract law; the defect is the missing pin and the draft label.
evidence: docs/implementation/m3/reviews/codex-m3-plan-r10/review.json verdict ACCEPT, requiredFindings [], subjectBytes 226011, subjectSha256 ec8c38f8c6ac8d522989ea6226363817a1b77c5b37560e72e2520088601bb964. diffBase is M3-PLAN-r9.md, 150586 bytes, sha256 72bc7a135014072fd06b84211f0535a0fece8b14280d0dc16059e6240de54a17.

Current docs/implementation/m3/M3-PLAN-r10.md is 226011 bytes and sha256 ec8c38f8c6ac8d522989ea6226363817a1b77c5b37560e72e2520088601bb964. Current docs/implementation/m3/M3-PLAN.md is 226459 bytes and sha256 af4f835c969887ffd1aebbd3046791efb7bd9dcb4c3e24f5e320918781692e36 because an acceptance note was prepended.
M3-PLAN-r10.md states that the record is not law, not code, and not a contract successor. IMPLEMENTATION.md line 7 calls that same record explicitly a draft.
requiredFindings.requestedChange: In PLAN-AMENDMENT-r2.md and IMPLEMENTATION.md, name docs/implementation/m3/M3-PLAN-r10.md with 226011 bytes and sha256 ec8c38f8c6ac8d522989ea6226363817a1b77c5b37560e72e2520088601bb964, and cite docs/implementation/m3/reviews/codex-m3-plan-r10/review.json. State that the record is planning and is not contract law, that its cutoff is earlier than product f5f5b4d20eca34ab2312b3ffc141c378da326afe, and that this amendment preserves r10's unit scopes, durations, and later accepted unit laws. Remove the draft-only label and the unresolved resolve-before-publishing instruction. Pin M3-PLAN-r10.md, not the noted M3-PLAN.md.

validation.conditionalBinding: Bind only after FX-CAP-1 and FX-COMP-1 are bound, so these CONTRACT candidate pins are accepted. This review does not bind them. Acceptance of the overlay also waits on FX-PLAN-1-RF-01.
